## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits, such as `feat(identity-service): ...`, `fix(cli): ...`, or `docs: ...`.
- [ ] Documentation, CLI help, and `.env.example` reflect applicable behavior or configuration changes.
- [ ] Dependency changes include an updated `pnpm-lock.yaml` and a successful `pnpm peers check`, when applicable.
- [ ] No API keys, `.env` files, or user configuration containing secrets are included; `.env.example` contains placeholders only.
